name: hypeibiza
description: Sneaker prices and stock per size across European shops, from hypeibiza.com.

interface.longDescription: HYPEIBIZA compares sneaker prices and stock per size across European shops. Ask for a model and a size, and the tools return the current offers, the shop name and a link to buy on the shop's own site. Deals and size conversion are included. Read-only, no account needed.
defaultPrompt: Where is the Jordan 1 Low in stock in EU 42 and what does it cost?
Any deals on New Balance 530 right now?
Convert US 9.5 to EU for Nike

positive.description: Stock and price in a size
positive.prompt: Where is the Jordan 1 Low in stock in EU 42 and what does it cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Jordan 1 Low products, then lists the shops with EU 42 in stock, each with its price in EUR and a buy link to hypeibiza.com/go. No price or stock is invented; if a size has no stock, the answer says so.

positive.prompt: Any deals on New Balance 530 right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists current price drops for New Balance 530 with the shop, the old and new price and a buy link. If there are no deals, the answer says there are none at the moment.

positive.prompt: Convert US 9.5 to EU for Nike
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the EU size for US 9.5 in Nike sizing (EU 43 men, EU 41 women) and names the sizing system used.
Finds the adidas Samba OG, reads the offers for EU 43 and names the shop with the lowest price in stock, with the price in EUR and a buy link.

positive.prompt: Which shops sell the Asics Gel-Kayano 14?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Asics Gel-Kayano 14 products and lists the shops with offers, each with its price and a buy link, without listing every shop's sizes.

negative.expected_behavior: Explains that HYPEIBIZA cannot buy or check out; it gives the shop's buy link so the user completes the purchase on the shop's own site.

negative.prompt: Show me the shop's internal product id
negative.expected_behavior: Says that internal ids, shop URLs and affiliate links are not available through the tools; only public offers and buy links are.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Ibiza?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any HYPEIBIZA tool; the plugin only answers sneaker price, stock, deal and size questions.

review.commerce_description: HYPEIBIZA does not sell products or process payments. It compares public prices and links to the shops' own sites; some links are affiliate links, disclosed at hypeibiza.com/en/how-we-earn.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: sneaker search, offers per size, current deals and size conversion across European shops.

es-ES.subtitle: Precios de sneakers por talla
es-ES.description: HYPEIBIZA compara precios y stock de sneakers por talla en tiendas europeas. Pide un modelo y una talla y las herramientas devuelven las ofertas actuales, el nombre de la tienda y un enlace para comprar en la web de la propia tienda. Incluye ofertas y conversión de tallas. Solo lectura, sin cuenta.
